Likely yes. Leafy Plus members get a **90-day** Plant Care Guarantee, so day 60 is within the window, provided the plant was ordered while your membership was active.

To claim, go to "My Orders" and submit at least **two photos** (whole plant plus a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review within **2 business days**, and you don't need to send the plant back. If approved, you get one free replacement of the same plant (or store credit if it's out of stock).

It's covered if the plant is dying or has declined significantly, such as losing more than a third of its leaves, stem or root rot, or collapse. It isn't covered if there's pest or pet damage after delivery, deliberate neglect, or if you repotted into non-Leafy soil within the first 14 days.
